title: Simone de Beauvoir and "the Lesbian"/Simone de Beauvoir et "la lesbienne"

chunks.text:
# Simone de Beauvoir and "the Lesbian"/Simone de Beauvoir et "la lesbienne"

Online symposium organised with the International Simone de Beauvoir Society

Colloque en ligne organisé avec la Société Internationale Simone de Beauvoir

17th-18th November, 2025/17-18 novembre 2025

Opening remarks (New York 02:15; Paris 08:15; New Delhi 12:45; Melbourne 18:15)

## Panel 1: Beauvoir's Lesbian Ethics/L'éthique lesbienne de Beauvoir

New York 02:30-04:00; Paris 08:30-10:00; New Delhi 13:00-14:30; Melbourne 18:30-20:00

Lucie Boulay

Expérience lesbienne vécue : une transcendance rendue ?

Talia Fell

Authenticity and "The Lesbian"

Marie Günther

Transcendence, Existentialism, and Oppression in Simone de Beauvoir's Les Inséparables

## Break/Pause (15 minutes)

## Panel 2: Beauvoir as a Critic of Heterosexuality/Beauvoir, critique de l'hétérosexualité

New York 04:15-05:45; Paris 10:15-11:45; New Delhi 14:45-16:15; Melbourne 20:15-21:45

Christian Meyer

Lesbianism as Gender Nonconformity in The Second Sex

Thomas Chesworth

Ambiguous Lesbians: Beauvoirian Anti-Essentialism in Monique Wittig's 'One is Not Born a Woman'

Alexandra Umarova

The Inseparables as a Critique of Heterosexuality, and "The Lesbian" from The Second Sex as a Critique of Lesbianism

Break/Pause (15 minutes)

## Panel 3: Blurring the Boundaries Between Friendship and the Erotic/Estomper les frontières entre l'amitié et l'érotisme

New York 06:00-07:00; Paris 12:00-13:00; New Delhi 16:30-17:30; Melbourne 22:00-23:00

Madeleine Banatvala Blurred boundaries and the Ineffable: Beauvoir on same-sex friendships and lesbian relationships in Les Inséparables

Simran Tapaswi Lesbian Desire and the Asexual Erotic in Inseparables

## LONG BREAK / LONGUE PAUSE

## Panel 4: Reading the Lesbian/Lire la lesbienne

New York 13:00-15:00; Paris 19:00-21:00; New Delhi 23:30-01:30 (18/11); Melbourne 05:00-07:00 (18/11)

Ruth Thrush Simone de Beauvoir and Modernist Lesbian Style

Marine Rouch Readers of "the Lesbian" since the '50s

Emma McNicol Polyphony in La Lesbienne

Eleanor Kaufman Beauvoir's Object Relations

## Break/Pause (15 minutes)

Roundtable discussion/Table ronde: The Women's Studies International Forum special issue, 40 years on/Le numéro spécial de Women's Studies International Forum, 40 ans après

New York 15:15-16:30; Paris 21:15-22:30; New Delhi 01:45-03:00 (18/11); Melbourne 07:15-08:30 (18/11)

Discussants/Discutant.e.s: Sophia Millman, Claudia Bouliane, Alexandre Antolin

Chair/Modération: Thomas Chesworth
